.github/actions/prepare-product-updates/.name: Release notes bundling
.github/actions/prepare-product-updates/.description: Bundles the approved release notes and screenshots into the server image before it is built.

.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml.name: Security scan settings
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml.description: Tells the security scanner which generated and third-party folders to skip and which warnings are expected.

.github/dependabot.yml.name: Dependency update bot
.github/dependabot.yml.description: Checks weekly for newer versions of libraries and base images and opens a pull request for each group.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml.name: Bug report form
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml.description: Asks for a clear summary, reproduction steps and expected behaviour when someone reports a fault.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/chore.yml.name: Maintenance request form
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/chore.yml.description: Collects a short description and scope for small upkeep tasks that are neither bugs nor new features.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml.name: Issue form settings
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml.description: Controls whether blank issues are allowed and which outside links appear when someone starts a new issue.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml.name: Feature request form
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml.description: Asks what problem a new capability solves and how it should behave before any work starts.

.github/workflows/ci-noop.yml.name: Doc-only change pass
.github/workflows/ci-noop.yml.description: Reports the required checks as passed for documentation and config changes so they are not blocked from merging.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.name: Main checks
.github/workflows/ci.yml.description: Runs the code checks, automatic tests and browser tests on every proposed change before it can merge.

.github/workflows/codeql.yml.name: Security scanning
.github/workflows/codeql.yml.description: Scans the code for known unsafe patterns and reports any findings in the repository's security tab.

.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge..name: Safe dependency merging
.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge..description: Merges routine library updates once checks pass, while leaving major upgrades and base images for a person to review.

.github/workflows/dependabot-lockfile-re.name: Dependency lock refresh
.github/workflows/dependabot-lockfile-re.description: Rebuilds the pinned dependency list on update pull requests so their checks run against a current lock.

.github/workflows/nightly.yml.name: Nightly browser sweep
.github/workflows/nightly.yml.description: Runs the full set of browser journeys every night to catch problems the quick checks miss.

.github/workflows/product-updates.yml.name: Release note checks
.github/workflows/product-updates.yml.description: Verifies that each change records a product-update decision and that the approved notes read correctly.

.github/workflows/scorecard.yml.name: Open source health score
.github/workflows/scorecard.yml.description: Scores the project's security practices weekly and publishes the result in the repository and on a public badge.

.github/workflows/floorplan-refresh.yml.name: Architecture map upkeep
.github/workflows/floorplan-refresh.yml.description: Refreshes the map on a timetable and opens a pull request when file names or requests have changed.

.github/workflows/floorplan.yml.name: Architecture map check
.github/workflows/floorplan.yml.description: Re-reads the code on every change and fails when the map no longer matches it.

.github/workflows/dev-worker-image.yml.name: Dev worker image
.github/workflows/dev-worker-image.yml.description: Builds a worker container image for a dev branch so external capacity can run it.
